scheme_name: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Children whose parents are working in a factory or institute in Gujarat and have been paying the Labour Welfare Fund
Children of labourers who have secured 70% or higher marks in the 10th Standard or 12th Standard
benefits_summary: Award of ₹2,500 for 10th‑pass students and ₹5,000 for 12th‑pass students who score 70% or higher.
